countedBy: lane #207 (opus) from the rectified panorama crops of the brief; zones follow the photo's split levels; a door, a louvre and an entrance bay count.

facades.name: Linnaeusstraat front, north zone
facades.note: w02-250 (recording_2025-06-19_10-17-35_00977, 49.8 px/m). The glazed corner bay and columns 1-5: low windows with blinds, short timber windows, tall timber windows with a transom, then two aluminium storeys. A zone of its own because its floors sit at other levels than the middle and south zones (split-level plan).

facades.name: Linnaeusstraat front, middle zone
facades.note: w02-250: columns 6-10: low windows with blinds, tall timber windows 3.8-7.3, three aluminium storeys.

facades.name: Linnaeusstraat front, south zone and entrance
facades.note: w02-250 columns 11-14 and w05-249 (TMX7316010203-001679_pano_0000_001268, 2020) columns 15-16 and the corner bay: four tall ground windows and the two entrance bays, short timber windows, three aluminium storeys; the corner bay has no ground window.

facades.name: south face
facades.note: w04-161 (TMX7316010203-001679_pano_0000_001262, 44.9 px/m): the corner bay and columns 1-8; the entrance porch under column 1 and seven tall timber ground windows; short timber windows; three aluminium storeys.

facades.name: south face, garage bay
facades.note: w04-161: the garage door in its grey stone frame under columns 9-11, then columns 9-11 and the corner bay on every storey. Cropped apart because the roller door is one 4.4 m opening, not a window of the row. The 0.45 m of corner glass at the right edge (the wrap of the east face's corner bay) is not counted: the model draws that corner bay on the east face only.

facades.name: east face, south zone
facades.note: w01-71 (TMX7316010203-001679_pano_0000_001255, 49.9 px/m, 48 deg oblique): the corner bay and columns 1-6 over blank brick panels (no ground openings): short timber windows, three aluminium storeys.

facades.name: east face, middle zone
facades.note: w01-71: columns 7-13: six steel doors under 7-12, tall timber windows 3.8-7.3, three aluminium storeys.

facades.name: east face, north zone
facades.note: w01-71: columns 14-17 and the corner bay over blank brick: short timber windows, tall timber windows, two aluminium storeys.

facades.name: north face
facades.note: w03-341 (recording_2024-09-16_10-54-06_01928, 48.6 px/m): twelve columns and both corner bays: ground has the door under column 5, three louvres under 10-12 and the glazed west corner bay; short timber windows, tall timber windows, two aluminium storeys; POLITIE between the top two storeys at the west end. The 0.45 m of corner glass at the right edge (the wrap of the Linnaeusstraat corner bay) is not counted: the model draws that corner bay on the Linnaeusstraat face only.
